project_info.theme: Toyota Hybrid Electric fuel-saving myth-busting and engagement
project_info.color_palette: Ice blue, white, dark blue, royal blue, soft silver

main_subject.detail: A clean hybrid-engagement poster with the Toyota logo top left and a large title 'HOI KHO - DAP DE cung TOYOTA HYBRID ELECTRIC'. Centered is a browser-window style white card containing the statement 'CO THE BAN CHUA BIET: "Di xe Hybrid, ghe tram xang co the chi con mot nua." Nho kha nang tiet kiem den 55% nhien lieu trong dieu kien do thi.' Below that text asks 'BAN CON BAN KHOAN DIEU GI VE KHA NANG TIET KIEM NHIEN LIEU CUA TOYOTA HYBRID?'. At the bottom sits a white Toyota SUV in side view, a cute blue-and-green robot mascot on the right, voucher and gift-box graphics in the lower-left corner labeled 'VOUCHER GOTIT 500.000 VND', and a blue CTA button reading 'THAM GIA NGAY'. Bottom-right script says 'Move your world'.
main_subject.style: Clean social CTA poster mixing educational UI card, product side profile, mascot illustration, and promotional gift elements

prompt.generated_prompt_string: High quality advertising poster for a Toyota Hybrid Electric fuel-saving engagement campaign. Centerpiece is a large white browser-window style card above a side-view white Toyota hybrid SUV, explaining that hybrid drivers may visit gas stations only half as often thanks to savings up to 55% in urban conditions. Background is a soft icy blue gradient. Surrounding elements: Toyota logo, exact title 'HOI KHO - DAP DE cung TOYOTA HYBRID ELECTRIC', the exact educational quote and follow-up question text, a cute robot mascot, Got It voucher and gift-box graphics labeled 'VOUCHER GOTIT 500.000 VND', a blue CTA button 'THAM GIA NGAY', and footer script 'Move your world'. Technical style: automotive social poster with UI-card compositing and product render integration, soft digital-commercial lighting, clean glow and crisp card shadows, 8k resolution, highly detailed.
